title: ensure-branch.mjs rejects --name=main and --name=master
goal: Never let ensure-branch.mjs --name=<protected> check the caller directly onto a protected branch.
in_scope: Check explicitName against PROTECTED before comparing it to the current branch or calling switchTo(), so the rejection applies regardless of starting state (feature branch, already on main, or detached HEAD)
out_of_scope: Any change to the auto-generate (no --name) path, which already treats detached HEAD / main / master as protected correctly
acceptance: Both names exit non-zero and leave the working tree exactly where it was, whether called from a feature branch, from main itself, or from detached HEAD.
invariants: Non-protected --name= values (e.g. epic/E-1-thing) are completely unaffected
